name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 16 – Am 26
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 16a. Recalls that families are the main pillar that supports the social expenditure of the EU, especially those with children in their care, and that they therefore must be the subject of special attention in all aspects of the EU budget, in the fiscal policy recommendations and in the European Pillar of Social Rights priorities;
